subject: [PATCH v2 3/3] nfsd: compare CB_GETATTR times against the inode

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch updates the NFS server to compare client-reported timestamps in CB_GETATTR requests against the current timestamp of the inode, rather than stale values stored in the delegation. This change prevents clients from reporting outdated timestamps and ensures that file metadata is accurately updated. The patch also removes unnecessary fields from the delegation structure and fixes a bug related to SETATTR updates for delegated timestamps.
